name: Plain
one_liner: API-first customer support platform (plain.com) whose whole product is exposed via a single GraphQL API.
auth_notes: GraphQL endpoint https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1 with Authorization: Bearer <API key> from a machine user with fine-grained permissions. OAuth only for the MCP server (acts as the user).
access_notes: Pricing page: 'Start today, no credit card required.' Paid plans Foundation $45-55 and Horizon $99 per user/month billed annually; no plan gate on API or machine users stated.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve trial, machine-user API key, broad GraphQL API (178 queries, 268 mutations per llms.txt) and signed webhook targets. API plan gating not stated; rate limits not found.

evidence.quote: Support for teams that ship. Start today, no credit card required.
The Plain MCP server at `https://mcp.plain.com/mcp` lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.
A webhook target is an HTTP endpoint Plain delivers events to, subscribed to the events you choose.

disputes.why: Pricing page states no credit card required to start; API key creation is in-product.
Official llms.txt lists 178 queries and 268 mutations.
Webhook targets, ~50 event types and HMAC request signing documented.
Pricing page resolves access question; API plan-gating still unstated but low risk.
